criteria.note: The washing machine stands on the tiled floor and the floor around and in front of it is visible.
No drip tray under the washing machine and no floor drain is visible; it only sits on small feet.
The tiled floor near the washing machine looks dry, with no visible puddles or water stains.

boxes.label: floor in front of washing machine

assessment.fixSuggestion: Place a drip tray under the washing machine, or make sure a floor drain is nearby so a leak would show at once.
